title: 2027 Budget & Finance Planner | Excel + Google Sheets
etsy_title: 2027 Budget Planner Spreadsheet, Google Sheets & Excel Budget Template, Monthly Budget Tracker, Debt Payoff, Savings Tracker
description:
Stop wondering where your money went. Start 2027 knowing exactly where it's going.

This all-in-one budget spreadsheet turns 10 minutes a week into total clarity about your money. Log what you earn and spend; the dashboard does the math.

WHAT'S INSIDE (7 tabs)
- Dashboard: income vs. expenses chart, spending pie chart, savings rate, running balance, 12-month overview
- Budget vs. actual for 18 renameable categories; overspending turns red automatically
- Transaction log: 1,000 rows, category dropdown, income/expense detected automatically
- Savings goals: tells you how much to save per month to hit each deadline
- Debt payoff planner: months to payoff, debt-free date, total interest, extra-payment effect
- Bill tracker: tick off recurring bills month by month
- Works in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Apple Numbers, LibreOffice. Printable (each tab fits one page).
- Instant digital download, personal-use license, no subscription, no bank login

Amounts are shown in $. Instant download after purchase: open in Excel, or in Google Sheets use File > Import > Upload. Start on the "Start Here" tab.

This is a digital product. No physical item will be shipped.

Designed with the help of AI tools and checked by the shop owner.

social_posts.text:
The budgeting habit that finally stuck for me: one 10-minute check-in every Sunday. Log the week's spending, compare each category to its budget, move money if something's over. Skip the apps that need your bank login; a simple spreadsheet works.

I made the one I use into a template if anyone wants it: {link}

Tip for anyone starting a budget for the new year: give every category a monthly number, then track only the difference between plan and actual. That's the whole trick.

I built a spreadsheet that does the math automatically: {link}

POV: it's 2027 and you actually know where your money goes 💸
Dashboard, savings goals, debt payoff, bill tracker, all automatic.
Link in bio 👆 #budgeting #moneytips #debtfree #savingmoney #budgetplanner
